description: Read the top reviews Amazon shows logged out on a product page, for ASINs or product URLs on amazon.co.uk, .de, .fr, .it, .es, .ca, .co.jp, and .in: about 8 from the marketplace country and up to 5 from other countries, plus the rating, ratings count, and star split. One product row and one row per review. Costs 0.03 USD per product, 0.002 USD per ASIN not on that marketplace, plus a run start. No US marketplace, no paging, no sort.

include_other_countries.description: yes (default) or no. The page also shows about 3 to 5 top reviews from other countries, which can include the United States. No keeps only the marketplace's own country.

include_reviewer_names.description: no (default) or yes. Yes adds the public display name Amazon shows on each review.

marketplace.description: Marketplace for ASINs given without a URL. amazon.co.uk (default), amazon.de, amazon.fr, amazon.it, amazon.es, amazon.ca, amazon.co.jp, or amazon.in. amazon.com is not supported: its logged out pages show no reviews.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

products.description: ASINs or Amazon product URLs. A URL sets its own marketplace; an ASIN uses Marketplace below. From Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

name: get_amazon_top_reviews
title: Get Amazon top reviews
